back: A body remains at rest or moves with constant velocity unless a resultant force acts on it.
$F = ma$, where $F$ is the resultant force (N), $m$ the mass (kg), $a$ the acceleration (m s$^{-2}$).
If A exerts a force on B, then B exerts an equal and opposite force on A. The pair acts on different bodies.
Reaction on a passenger: $R = m(g + a)$.
Reaction on a passenger: $R = m(g - a)$.
Zero acceleration, so the resultant force is zero: driving force = resistance.
